name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Ollama 0.13.5: gpt-oss:120b eval rate
methodology: Ollama 0.13.5 on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB GDDR7 (compute capability 12.0). llama.cpp commit not printed. Quantization is the default Ollama pull, labelled 4-bit, exact GGUF quant not printed, format_id null. Prompt is the single question 'What is GPU?'; output length is model-determined. Eval rate is per-request decode, batch size 1, NOT aggregate. Not comparable to the Hardware Corner llama-bench rows for this card, which use fixed pp/tg lengths and a named GGUF quant. This row generated 2729 tokens; model size 65 GB.
notes: GPU util 60%, GPU memory 77%. A 120B-class model decoding faster than the 70B dense row on the same card.
